objective: Condense and optimize the complete NVM Knowledge Hub across Windows desktop and 390px mobile while preserving readability, evidence fidelity, bilingual behavior and enterprise identity.
constraints: Preserve the existing static-site architecture and current user-owned changes.
Preserve technical meaning and evidence boundaries.
Prefer systemic fixes over one-off visual patches.
Keep the host as the only integration writer.
Do not commit, push or deploy without explicit authorization.

currentLoop.title: Whole-site responsive density and cadence optimization
successCriteria: All four page families use a tighter shared section, heading and panel rhythm on desktop and mobile.
Substantive body text remains at least 15px and mobile headings remain at most 44px.
Repeated card runs are condensed without deleting technical or evidence content.
Desktop 1280px and mobile 390px render without clipping, overlap or horizontal overflow.
English modes contain no unintended Chinese outside explicit language controls.
Rendered verification reports no P0 or P1 issue.

tasks.output: four-family desktop and mobile rendered gates
